scenario_description: The sandbox limits and cleans a component attempting to create four hundred processes.
expected: Process creation is refused with errno 11 below 256 children and the component exits zero.
The structured output contract passes, the component hash matches, and cleanup is confirmed.
observed: Preflight read pids.max=256 from the live cgroup.
The attempt to start four hundred sleeps was refused after 252 children with errno 11; the fixture terminated and waited for each child.
The component exited zero with a valid blocked=true artifact, its hash matched, and exact cleanup left no container.
notes: PASS covers one frozen PID-pressure calibration; it is not a general denial-of-service proof.
